claims: School schedules for many in the D.C. area are impacted on March 16, 2026, due to severe weather.
Multiple districts in D.C., Maryland, and Virginia are reporting early dismissals or closures.
DC Public Schools has a 2-hour early dismissal on March 16, 2026.
Montgomery County Public Schools is open but monitoring weather on March 16, 2026.
Prince George's County Public Schools has an early dismissal on March 16, 2026.
Fairfax County Public Schools has a 3-hour early dismissal on March 16, 2026.
Some Virginia schools have closures in areas like Culpeper and Stafford on March 16, 2026.
There are no nationwide federal holidays on March 16, 2026 that would cause a universal school closure.
